title: CD39+CD71+ erythroid cells exhibit enhanced purine metabolism and T cell-suppressive function in triple-negative breast cancer and other immunoregulatory settings.
snippet: CD71+ erythroid cells (CECs) expand in tumor-bearing hosts and suppress antitumor immunity, but the mechanisms underlying their immunoregulatory activity remain incompletely understood. title: Biosemantic graph transfer learning for cross-patient cell type annotation and cell-cell interaction analysis in tumor single-cell RNA sequencing.
